metadata.purpose: Rules and scoring configuration for identifying high-potential personal loan customers from raw bank customer data.
metadata.recommended_approach: Apply hard filters first, then calculate a weighted score for remaining customers. Use matched rule count only as a secondary tie-breaker.

scoring_method.reason: Weighted scoring is preferred because some signals indicate much stronger intent or suitability than others. A simple count can over-rank customers who match many weak signals while under-ranking customers who match fewer but stronger signals.

ui_sections.section_description: Mandatory checks applied before scoring. If a customer fails any hard filter, they should not be shortlisted for this campaign, regardless of how many positive signals they have.

rules.description: Checks whether the customer has permitted the bank to send marketing or promotional communication.
rules.business_rationale: Customers without marketing consent should not be contacted for campaign outreach.
rules.condition_summary: marketing_consent must be true

rules.description: Checks whether the customer has opted into Do Not Disturb or similar communication suppression preferences.
rules.business_rationale: Customers marked as DND should be suppressed from proactive outreach to avoid consent and customer-experience issues.
rules.condition_summary: dnd_flag must be false

rules.description: Checks whether the customer's Know Your Customer status is valid and up to date.
rules.business_rationale: Loan outreach should not be prioritized for customers whose KYC status may block loan processing.
rules.condition_summary: kyc_status must be Valid

rules.description: Checks whether the customer's primary relationship/account status is active.
rules.business_rationale: Frozen, dormant, or inactive accounts may create operational or compliance issues during loan fulfilment.
rules.condition_summary: account_status must be Active

rules.description: Checks whether the customer's profile has an active fraud-related flag.
rules.business_rationale: Customers with fraud flags should not be included in automated or semi-automated loan campaigns.
rules.condition_summary: service_interactions.fraud_flag must be false

rules.description: Checks whether the customer currently has an unresolved complaint with the bank.
rules.business_rationale: Campaign outreach during an unresolved complaint can worsen customer experience and should be avoided.
rules.condition_summary: service_interactions.active_complaint must be false

rules.description: Checks whether the customer has had any repayment delinquency in the last 12 months.
rules.business_rationale: Recent delinquency indicates repayment risk and should block proactive loan outreach.
rules.condition_summary: credit_profile.delinquency_last_12m must be false

rules.description: Checks whether the customer has been marked under SMA, NPA, or loan restructuring status in the last 12 months.
rules.business_rationale: Such statuses indicate elevated credit risk and should prevent campaign shortlisting.
rules.condition_summary: credit_profile.sma_npa_or_restructured_last_12m must be false

rules.display_name: No Recent NACH or Cheque Bounce
rules.description: Checks whether the customer had any NACH or cheque bounce in the last 3 months.
rules.business_rationale: Recent payment bounces suggest short-term liquidity or repayment discipline issues.
rules.condition_summary: credit_profile.nach_or_cheque_bounce_count_3m must be 0

ui_sections.section_description: Rules used to rank customers after they pass the hard filters. Higher scores indicate stronger potential for loan outreach this month.

categories.description: Signals showing that the customer may already be actively thinking about or exploring a loan.

rules.display_name: Loan Application Started but Not Submitted
rules.description: Customer started a loan application but did not complete submission.
rules.business_rationale: This is one of the strongest intent signals because the customer has already shown direct interest.
rules.condition_summary: loan_application_status is Started_Not_Submitted and loan_application_started_date is within the last 30 days

ui_hint.tooltip: Customer began the loan journey but did not finish it.

rules.description: Customer used the EMI calculator recently.
rules.business_rationale: EMI calculator usage suggests active planning around loan amount, tenure, and affordability.
rules.condition_summary: emi_calculator_last_used_date is within the last 14 days

ui_hint.tooltip: Customer recently explored EMI options.

rules.description: Customer visited the loan product page multiple times in the last 30 days.
rules.business_rationale: Repeated visits reduce the chance of accidental interest and indicate active product comparison or consideration.
rules.condition_summary: loan_product_page_sessions_30d is greater than or equal to 3

ui_hint.tooltip: Customer viewed loan product content multiple times.

rules.description: Customer clicked a loan offer or campaign link recently.
rules.business_rationale: Click behavior indicates engagement with a specific offer, even if an application was not started.
rules.condition_summary: loan_offer_clicked_date is within the last 30 days

ui_hint.tooltip: Customer interacted with a loan offer.

rules.description: Customer contacted the branch or call center with a loan-related inquiry.
rules.business_rationale: A spoken or assisted-channel inquiry is a strong sign of serious interest and may need quick follow-up.
rules.condition_summary: last_loan_related_inquiry_date is within the last 30 days

ui_hint.tooltip: Customer recently asked about a loan through a service channel.

rules.description: Customer has a recent bureau enquiry for a personal loan.
rules.business_rationale: This can indicate that the customer is shopping for credit and may be comparing lenders.
rules.condition_summary: personal_loan_bureau_enquiry_date is within the last 45 days

ui_hint.tooltip: Customer may be exploring personal loan options externally.

categories.description: Signals that indicate whether the customer appears financially stable and suitable for responsible loan outreach.

rules.description: Customer has received salary credits consistently for at least 6 months.
rules.business_rationale: Stable salary credit gives the bank confidence about recurring income and repayment capacity.
rules.condition_summary: salary_account is true and salary_credit_months is greater than or equal to 6

ui_hint.tooltip: Salary has been credited consistently for 6+ months.

rules.display_name: No Missed EMI in Last 24 Months
rules.description: Customer has no missed EMI records in the last 24 months.
rules.business_rationale: Clean repayment behavior is a strong indicator of future repayment discipline.
rules.condition_summary: missed_emi_count_24m equals 0

ui_hint.tooltip: No missed EMI recorded in the last 24 months.

rules.description: Customer's bureau score is above the preferred threshold.
rules.business_rationale: A higher bureau score indicates stronger external credit behavior and may support better pricing or faster approval.
rules.condition_summary: bureau_score is greater than or equal to 740

ui_hint.tooltip: Bureau score is at or above the preferred threshold.

rules.description: Customer belongs to an acceptable internal risk band.
rules.business_rationale: Internal risk bands use the bank's own relationship and behavior data to assess customer risk.
rules.condition_summary: internal_risk_band is A or B

ui_hint.tooltip: Customer falls within internal risk bands A or B.

rules.description: Customer has a positive pre-approved personal loan amount available in the bank's system.
rules.business_rationale: Pre-approved availability makes the campaign more actionable and can reduce fulfilment friction.
rules.condition_summary: pre_approved_personal_loan_amount is greater than 0

ui_hint.tooltip: Customer has a positive pre-approved personal loan limit.

categories.description: Signals that may indicate a current or recent financial need. These should be used carefully and mostly for internal prioritization, not intrusive messaging.

rules.description: Customer's current credit card utilization is high and has increased sharply compared with 30 days ago.
rules.business_rationale: A utilization spike can indicate recent high spending or short-term liquidity need, especially when repayment behavior is clean.
rules.condition_summary: current utilization is at least 50% and has increased by at least 20 percentage points compared with 30 days ago
rules.personalization_guidance: Do not explicitly mention card utilization in customer-facing messages.

ui_hint.tooltip: Current card utilization is high and has increased materially.

rules.description: Customer closed a fixed deposit within the recent observation window.
rules.business_rationale: A recent FD closure may indicate liquidity need or a large planned expense.
rules.condition_summary: fd_closed_last_60d is true
rules.personalization_guidance: Use only for internal prioritization. Avoid saying the bank noticed FD closure.

ui_hint.tooltip: Customer closed an FD in the recent period.

rules.description: Customer redeemed mutual fund holdings within the recent observation window.
rules.business_rationale: A redemption may indicate liquidity need or planned spending.
rules.condition_summary: mf_redeemed_last_60d is true
rules.personalization_guidance: Use only for internal prioritization. Avoid explicitly mentioning redemption in outreach.

ui_hint.tooltip: Customer redeemed mutual fund holdings recently.

rules.description: Customer had a large debit in the last 30 days relative to monthly income.
rules.business_rationale: A large debit can indicate a recent major expense and may create a need for structured repayment or liquidity support.
rules.condition_summary: large_single_debit_amount_30d is at least 75% of monthly_income
rules.personalization_guidance: Avoid mentioning specific transaction categories unless the customer disclosed the need directly.

ui_hint.tooltip: Customer had a large debit compared with income.

rules.description: Customer's balance reached near-zero multiple times before salary credit.
rules.business_rationale: Repeated pre-salary low balance can indicate a recurring liquidity gap.
rules.condition_summary: balance_near_zero_before_salary_count_3m is greater than or equal to 2
rules.personalization_guidance: Do not mention low balance directly in customer-facing communication.

ui_hint.tooltip: Balance has dropped very low before salary more than once.

categories.description: Signals showing the depth, value, and maturity of the customer's relationship with the bank.

rules.description: Customer has been with the bank for at least 18 months.
rules.business_rationale: A longer relationship gives the bank more behavioral data and can improve trust and fulfilment confidence.
rules.condition_summary: bank_tenure_months is greater than or equal to 18

ui_hint.tooltip: Customer has a mature banking relationship.

rules.description: Customer's total relationship value is above the campaign threshold.
rules.business_rationale: Higher relationship value helps prioritize RM effort and personalized outreach.
rules.condition_summary: total_relationship_value is greater than or equal to 300000

ui_hint.tooltip: Customer has sufficient relationship value for prioritization.

rules.description: Customer holds at least three products with the bank.
rules.business_rationale: Multi-product customers typically have deeper engagement and richer internal data.
rules.condition_summary: products_held count is greater than or equal to 3

ui_hint.tooltip: Customer holds three or more bank products.

rules.description: Customer belongs to a higher-value customer segment.
rules.business_rationale: Preferred and Premium customers may justify more personalized relationship-manager outreach.
rules.condition_summary: customer_segment is Preferred or Premium

ui_hint.tooltip: Customer belongs to a higher-value service segment.

categories.description: Signals that help determine whether this is a good time to contact the customer and which channels may work best.

rules.description: Customer received salary credit in the last few days.
rules.business_rationale: Customers may be more financially confident and responsive immediately after salary credit.
rules.condition_summary: last_salary_credit_date is within the last 3 days

ui_hint.tooltip: Salary was credited recently.

rules.description: Customer has used the mobile app recently.
rules.business_rationale: Recent app activity increases the chance that digital messages or in-app offers will be seen.
rules.condition_summary: app_last_active_date is within the last 7 days

ui_hint.tooltip: Customer was active on the app in the last 7 days.

rules.description: Customer has not received recent marketing outreach.
rules.business_rationale: Suppressing recently contacted customers reduces fatigue and improves campaign experience.
rules.condition_summary: last_marketing_contact_date is older than 30 days or null

ui_hint.tooltip: Customer has not been contacted recently.

rules.description: Customer has a preferred outreach channel recorded.
rules.business_rationale: Using the customer's preferred channel can improve reachability and response rates.
rules.condition_summary: preferred_contact_channel is not null

ui_hint.tooltip: Customer has a recorded preferred contact channel.

ui_sections.section_description: Score bands used to group customers after hard filters and weighted scoring.

bands.description: Highest-priority customers with strong intent, suitable credit profile, and good timing/contactability.
bands.suggested_action: Relationship manager call plus personalized message.

bands.description: Good candidates who show meaningful signals but may need lighter-touch outreach or additional validation.
bands.suggested_action: Digital offer followed by RM or assisted-channel follow-up.

bands.description: Moderate-potential customers suitable for nurture campaigns rather than immediate RM attention.
bands.suggested_action: Low-touch campaign or educational loan content.

bands.description: Customers with limited current signals for this month’s personal loan campaign.
bands.suggested_action: Do not prioritize for this campaign cycle.

notes.title: Use weighted score as the primary ranking method
notes.description: Intent and eligibility signals should not be treated equally. Weighted scoring prevents weak but numerous signals from overpowering fewer but stronger signals.

notes.title: Keep hard filters separate from scoring
notes.description: Hard filters should be binary gates. A customer who fails a consent, KYC, account status, fraud, complaint, or credit-risk gate should not be rescued by a high score.

notes.title: Use matched rule count only as a tie-breaker
notes.description: Matched parameter count is useful for explainability but should not be the main ranking metric.

notes.title: Do not over-personalize sensitive triggers
notes.description: Signals such as medical payments, low balances, utilization spikes, FD closure, or mutual fund redemption should usually be used internally and not directly referenced in customer-facing messages.

notes.title: Make thresholds configurable
notes.description: Values such as bureau score threshold, salary history threshold, utilization spike threshold, and campaign score bands should be configurable by risk, compliance, and business teams.
